verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS, a first-party toolkit and official MCP server that lets AI agents act on a production account, for example reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards and building cashflow reports. Users can therefore operate the account in natural language through an external agent, but the evidence shows no native natural-language interface, and the docs are thin on how commands map to actions. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface within Airwallex itself, detailed documentation of supported natural-language operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AgentOS working in practice.
